ingress.label: Ingress
ingress.body: The front door: the proxy that receives web traffic and sends it to the right app.

replica.label: Replicas
replica.body: Identical copies of your app running side by side to share traffic and survive a restart.

volume.label: Volume
volume.body: Storage that outlives the container, so files and data stay after a redeploy.

cert.label: Certificate
cert.body: The file that proves your domain is yours and lets browsers use HTTPS. It renews automatically.

aRecord.label: DNS
aRecord.body: DNS records, such as an A record, point your domain name at the IP address of this server.

reconciler.label: Reconciler
reconciler.body: The background loop that compares what you asked for with what is running and fixes any difference.

agent.label: Agent
agent.body: The small program on each node that runs containers for the control plane and reports back.
